title: Eleusinian mysteries as near-death rituals

tellings.quote: because if you look at the linian Mysteries or any of these other rituals they involve the temporary killing of the physical body through a near-death experience

plain: The Eleusinian Mysteries, secret initiation rites held in ancient Greece at Eleusis, and other rituals like them, worked by temporarily killing the physical body through a near-death experience. That is Michels's own reading, offered without a source, and it would mean the ancients were deliberately sending initiates to the edge of death to glimpse what lies beyond.
